www-6004710.name: The Elevator [1.8] [Crystals and Rainbows!]
www-6004710.author: Exelaratore
www-6004710.description: This elevator transports passengers up or down 16 floors and is a speedy alternative to the stairs. Enjoy! Most recent update [1.8] This is a partially minor update, It brings crystals and an updated previous floor. The updated floor is drastically different from the way it used to work. Enjoy! [1.7] Floor #16 is here! Previous floors have gotten some much needed attention. Floor 2 and floor 8 are much more involved now. Additionally they each have a star now! A hidden key was added, I wonder which door it opens? And last but not least, the glass button has gotten a major tech upgrade! Passengers may now cycle through elevator music! ♪ ♪ ♪ [1.6] Another two floors were added to the game, there is now a total of 15 floors! Along with these floors are two new stars to capture. Also, the button has blinded too many passengers, so a protective glass casing was installed. Enjoy! [1.5] includes two new floors! Some minor quality of life changes and exploit fixes. Also, a brand new shiny button has been installed! (I've never seen anything more shiny in my life!). [1.4] includes a new floor and all floors have been increased to one minute of duration (previously 40 seconds). Some quality-of-life changes were made and a star objective is introduced. Enjoy! [1.3] includes three new floors! Enjoy! [1.2] includes two new floors! Previous floors were tweaked and fixed (Yay they work now!) Misc. changes here and there. Enjoy! [1.1] includes a new *floor?*. The elevator is now automatic (Yay!) which means no more glitchyness. The flamethrower is now guarded by big flames, but don't worry, if you time it right you can grab the flamethrower before being burned to a crisp! Beach has some small additions. And lastly, Sound! I've added more sounds to enhance the atmosphere. Enjoy!
